newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES MARCH 21.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES MARCH 21.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from the noon broadcast of Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The winner of the bid to manage the Klaipeda free-economic zone should become clear before April 20. So far only one company, the Klaipeda Development Group, has submitted a bid. The main shareholder of the company is the U.S. based Baltic Fund.
- Lithuania and NATO have started started work to bring Lithuania's armed forces up to the alliance's standards.
